note: Gaia DR3 candidate LMC stars at their measured sky positions and observed BP-RP colors, intersected with the published 34.7-degree stellar disk plane at 49.59 kpc. Proper-motion and parallax cuts reduce Milky Way contamination. The plane is an ensemble distance approximation: individual stellar depths, disk thickness and gas are not measured here. The 9.86-kpc disk aperture follows this item's characteristic diameter; fainter outskirts continue beyond it. Brightness is compressed for display and colors are an ordered BP-RP palette. No invented stars or depth scatter.
